parameters.name: MX
parameters.description: Mass of the X boson [GeV], Eq.(414)

parameters.name: c1
parameters.description: Chern-Simons portal coupling c1 for XZZ/XZgamma, Eq.(48)

parameters.name: c2
parameters.description: Chern-Simons portal coupling c2 for XWW, Eq.(48)

parameters.name: WX
parameters.description: Total width of X boson, sum of partial widths Eq.(41)

lagrangian_terms.name: LXkin
lagrangian_terms.expression: -1/4 FS[X, mu, nu] FS[X, mu, nu] + 1/2 MX^2 X[mu] X[mu]

lagrangian_terms.name: LXZZ
lagrangian_terms.expression: c1/2*sw*Eps[mu, nu, lambda, rho]*X[mu]*Z[nu]*(del[Z[lambda], rho] - del[Z[rho], lambda])

lagrangian_terms.name: LXZgamma
lagrangian_terms.expression: c1*cw*Eps[mu, nu, lambda, rho]*X[mu]*Z[nu]*(del[A[lambda], rho] - del[A[rho], lambda])

lagrangian_terms.name: LXWW
lagrangian_terms.expression: c2*Eps[mu, nu, lambda, rho]*X[mu]*W[nu]*(del[Wbar[lambda], rho] - del[Wbar[rho], lambda]) + HC[c2*Eps[mu, nu, lambda, rho]*X[mu]*W[nu]*(del[Wbar[lambda], rho] - del[Wbar[rho], lambda])]
